1.web: After the death of Joshua, the children of Israel asked of Yahweh, saying, “Who should go up for us first against the Canaanites, to fight against them?”
1.asv: And it came to pass after the death of Joshua, that the children of Israel asked of Jehovah, saying, Who shall go up for us first against the Canaanites, to fight against them?

2.web: Yahweh said, “Judah shall go up. Behold, I have delivered the land into his hand.”
2.asv: And Jehovah said, Judah shall go up: behold, I have delivered the land into his hand.

3.web: Judah said to Simeon his brother, “Come up with me into my lot, that we may fight against the Canaanites; and I likewise will go with you into your lot.” So Simeon went with him.
3.asv: And Judah said unto Simeon his brother, Come up with me into my lot, that we may fight against the Canaanites; and I likewise will go with thee into thy lot. So Simeon went with him.

4.web: Judah went up, and Yahweh delivered the Canaanites and the Perizzites into their hand. They struck ten thousand men in Bezek.
4.asv: And Judah went up; and Jehovah delivered the Canaanites and the Perizzites into their hand: and they smote of them in Bezek ten thousand men.

5.web: They found Adoni-Bezek in Bezek, and they fought against him; and they struck the Canaanites and the Perizzites.
5.asv: And they found Adoni-bezek in Bezek; and they fought against him, and they smote the Canaanites and the Perizzites.

6.web: But Adoni-Bezek fled; and they pursued him, and caught him, and cut off his thumbs and his big toes.
6.asv: But Adoni-bezek fled; and they pursued after him, and caught him, and cut off his thumbs and his great toes.

7.web: Adoni-Bezek said, “Seventy kings, having their thumbs and their big toes cut off, scavenged under my table. As I have done, so God has done to me.” They brought him to Jerusalem, and he died there.
7.asv: And Adoni-bezek said, Threescore and ten kings, having their thumbs and their great toes cut off, gathered their food under my table: as I have done, so God hath requited me. And they brought him to Jerusalem, and he died there.

8.web: The children of Judah fought against Jerusalem, took it, struck it with the edge of the sword, and set the city on fire.
8.asv: And the children of Judah fought against Jerusalem, and took it, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and set the city on fire.

9.web: After that, the children of Judah went down to fight against the Canaanites who lived in the hill country, and in the South, and in the lowland.
9.asv: And afterward the children of Judah went down to fight against the Canaanites that dwelt in the hill-country, and in the South, and in the lowland.

10.web: Judah went against the Canaanites who lived in Hebron (now the name of Hebron before was Kiriath Arba); and they struck Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai.
10.asv: And Judah went against the Canaanites that dwelt in Hebron (now the name of Hebron beforetime was Kiriath-arba); and they smote Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai.

11.web: From there he went against the inhabitants of Debir. (Now the name of Debir before was Kiriath Sepher.)
11.asv: And from thence he went against the inhabitants of Debir. (Now the name of Debir beforetime was Kiriath-sepher.)

12.web: Caleb said, “I will give Achsah my daughter as wife to he who strikes Kiriath Sepher, and takes it.”
12.asv: And Caleb said, He that smiteth Kiriath-sepher, and taketh it, to him will I give Achsah my daughter to wife.

13.web: Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother, took it, so he gave him Achsah his daughter as wife.
13.asv: And Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter to wife.

14.web: When she came, she got him to ask her father for a field. She dismounted from off of her donkey; and Caleb said to her, “What would you like?”
14.asv: And it came to pass, when she came unto him, that she moved him to ask of her father a field: and she alighted from off her ass; and Caleb said unto her, What wouldest thou?

15.web: She said to him, “Give me a blessing; because you have set me in the land of the South, give me also springs of water.” Then Caleb gave her the upper springs and the lower springs.
15.asv: And she said unto him, Give me a blessing; for that thou hast set me in the land of the South, give me also springs of water. And Caleb gave her the upper springs and the nether springs.

16.web: The children of the Kenite, Moses’ brother-in-law, went up out of the city of palm trees with the children of Judah into the wilderness of Judah, which is in the south of Arad; and they went and lived with the people.
16.asv: And the children of the Kenite, Moses’ brother-in-law, went up out of the city of palm-trees with the children of Judah into the wilderness of Judah, which is in the south of Arad; and they went and dwelt with the people.

17.web: Judah went with Simeon his brother, and they struck the Canaanites who inhabited Zephath, and utterly destroyed it. The name of the city was called Hormah.
17.asv: And Judah went with Simeon his brother, and they smote the Canaanites that inhabited Zephath, and utterly destroyed it. And the name of the city was called Hormah.

18.web: Also Judah took Gaza with its border, and Ashkelon with its border, and Ekron with its border.
18.asv: Also Judah took Gaza with the border thereof, and Ashkelon with the border thereof, and Ekron with the border thereof.

19.web: Yahweh was with Judah; and drove out the inhabitants of the hill country; for he could not drive out the inhabitants of the valley, because they had chariots of iron.
19.asv: And Jehovah was with Judah; and drove out the inhabitants of the hill-country; for he could not drive out the inhabitants of the valley, because they had chariots of iron.

20.web: They gave Hebron to Caleb, as Moses had spoken: and he drove out there the three sons of Anak.
20.asv: And they gave Hebron unto Caleb, as Moses had spoken: and he drove out thence the three sons of Anak.

21.web: The children of Benjamin did not drive out the Jebusites who inhabited Jerusalem; but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Benjamin in Jerusalem to this day.
21.asv: And the children of Benjamin did not drive out the Jebusites that inhabited Jerusalem; but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Benjamin in Jerusalem unto this day.

22.web: The house of Joseph, they also went up against Bethel; and Yahweh was with them.
22.asv: And the house of Joseph, they also went up against Beth-el; and Jehovah was with them.

23.web: The house of Joseph sent to spy out Bethel. (Now the name of the city before was Luz.)
23.asv: And the house of Joseph sent to spy out Beth-el. (Now the name of the city beforetime was Luz.)

24.web: The watchers saw a man come out of the city, and they said to him, “Please show us the entrance into the city, and we will deal kindly with you.”
24.asv: And the watchers saw a man come forth out of the city, and they said unto him, Show us, we pray thee, the entrance into the city, and we will deal kindly with thee.

25.web: He showed them the entrance into the city; and they struck the city with the edge of the sword; but they let the man go and all his family.
25.asv: And he showed them the entrance into the city; and they smote the city with the edge of the sword; but they let the man go and all his family.

26.web: The man went into the land of the Hittites, and built a city, and called its name Luz, which is its name to this day.
26.asv: And the man went into the land of the Hittites, and built a city, and called the name thereof Luz, which is the name thereof unto this day.

27.web: Manasseh did not drive out the inhabitants of Beth Shean and its towns, nor Taanach and its towns, nor the inhabitants of Dor and its towns, nor the inhabitants of Ibleam and its towns, nor the inhabitants of Megiddo and its towns; but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.
27.asv: And Manasseh did not drive outthe inhabitants ofBeth-shean and its towns, norofTaanach and its towns, nor the inhabitants of Dor and its towns, nor the inhabitants of Ibleam and its towns, nor the inhabitants of Megiddo and its towns; but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.

28.web: When Israel had grown strong, they put the Canaanites to forced labor, and did not utterly drive them out.
28.asv: And it came to pass, when Israel was waxed strong, that they put the Canaanites to taskwork, and did not utterly drive them out.

29.web: Ephraim didn’t drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer; but the Canaanites lived in Gezer among them.
29.asv: And Ephraim drove not out the Canaanites that dwelt in Gezer; but the Canaanites dwelt in Gezer among them.

30.web: Zebulun didn’t drive out the inhabitants of Kitron, nor the inhabitants of Nahalol; but the Canaanites lived among them, and became subject to forced labor.
30.asv: Zebulun drove not out the inhabitants of Kitron, nor the inhabitants of Nahalol; but the Canaanites dwelt among them, and became subject to taskwork.

31.web: Asher didn’t drive out the inhabitants of Acco, nor the inhabitants of Sidon, nor of Ahlab, nor of Achzib, nor of Helbah, nor of Aphik, nor of Rehob;
31.asv: Asher drove not out the inhabitants of Acco, nor the inhabitants of Sidon, nor of Ahlab, nor of Achzib, nor of Helbah, nor of Aphik, nor of Rehob;

32.web: but the Asherites lived among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land; for they did not drive them out.
32.asv: but the Asherites dwelt among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land; for they did not drive them out.

33.web: Naphtali didn’t drive out the inhabitants of Beth Shemesh, nor the inhabitants of Beth Anath; but he lived among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land: nevertheless the inhabitants of Beth Shemesh and of Beth Anath became subject to forced labor.
33.asv: Naphtali drove not out the inhabitants of Beth-shemesh, nor the inhabitants of Beth-anath; but he dwelt among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land: nevertheless the inhabitants of Beth-shemesh and of Beth-anath became subject to taskwork.

34.web: The Amorites forced the children of Dan into the hill country; for they would not allow them to come down to the valley;
34.asv: And the Amorites forced the children of Dan into the hill-country; for they would not suffer them to come down to the valley;

35.web: but the Amorites would dwell in Mount Heres, in Aijalon, and in Shaalbim: yet the hand of the house of Joseph prevailed, so that they became subject to forced labor.
35.asv: but the Amorites would dwell in mount Heres, in Aijalon, and in Shaalbim: yet the hand of the house of Joseph prevailed, so that they became subject to taskwork.

36.web: The border of the Amorites was from the ascent of Akrabbim, from the rock, and upward.
36.asv: And the border of the Amorites was from the ascent of Akrabbim, from the rock, and upward.
